title.full: Who can activate the CPF Safety Switch

summary.text: No. Members must verify their identity before activating the CPF Safety Switch.

details.heading: Who can activate it
details.body: Trusted Contacts and other people cannot activate the CPF Safety Switch for a member. The member must verify their identity first.
